summary: Frontend-only responsive testing of Vendor Panel across 390x844 (iPhone 13), 768x1024 (iPad portrait) and 1440x900 (desktop). Verified drawer portal fix, all responsive layout fixes and desktop non-regression. All acceptance criteria met.

mobile_390x844.dashboard: PASS - no h-overflow (scrollW=390), H1 within viewport (x=16,w=358,y=90), KPI cards stack in 1 column, Recent Orders wraps cleanly
mobile_390x844.mobile_drawer: PASS - portal fix works; drawer bbox {x:0,y:0,w:390,h:844} occupies FULL viewport height (previously bug was 64px). All 7 nav testids visible: dashboard, orders, reservations, menu, menu-requests, ai-insights, pickup. Clicking mobile-nav-orders navigates and drawer closes automatically.
mobile_390x844.orders: PASS - no h-overflow. H1 'Order Management' wraps under 390, Kiosk/Scan buttons wrap to full-width, order cards stack cleanly
mobile_390x844.menu: PASS - no h-overflow. Cravitoo managed banner legible, single-column card grid on mobile
mobile_390x844.reports: PASS - no h-overflow. Filters 2-col layout, preset chips row, KPI cards 2 cols, CSV/PDF buttons fit

tablet_768x1024.reservations: PASS - scrollW=768; screenshot shows KPI cards in 4-col row, tomorrows reservations header clean, no overlap with nav

desktop_1440x900.reports: PASS - full-width filter row, 6 KPIs in 3-col+, table renders normally

critical_code_review_comments: Navbar.js correctly uses createPortal(document.body) to escape backdrop-filter clip container - solid fix.
Multiple 401 console errors observed on login page loads (likely /api/auth/me pre-login) - harmless but noisy; consider suppressing on public routes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vendor Panel is fully mobile/tablet/desktop responsive. Drawer portal fix confirmed working (full 844px height). Any future vendor page additions should follow same pattern: px-4 sm:px-6 padding, responsive H1 (text-3xl sm:text-4xl), grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 stacking, tables wrapped in overflow-x-auto with explicit min-width.
